traceability.notes: docs/stories/008.0-DEV-AUTO-FIX.story.md defines auto-fix behavior for missing @story annotations and simple annotation format issues, including safety, configurability, and selective enable/disable. The implementation in require-story-annotation and valid-annotation-format, together with their helper modules, fully implements these behaviors: auto-fix insertion uses conservative comment-only fixers; format fixes are restricted to safe suffix normalization of @story paths; both rules expose and honor configurable templates and autoFix toggles. Dedicated tests in tests/rules/auto-fix-behavior-008.test.ts exercise all specified requirements (REQ-AUTOFIX-MISSING, REQ-AUTOFIX-FORMAT, REQ-AUTOFIX-TEMPLATE, REQ-AUTOFIX-SELECTIVE) across multiple code patterns, and the full Jest suite passes. User-facing documentation in user-docs/api-reference.md accurately describes the auto-fix capabilities and options. Based on this concrete code, tests, and documentation, all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for Story 008.0-DEV-AUTO-FIX are satisfied.
